== Primary-source replacement wording and existing identity ==
This article documents the complete Decipher replacement, with no verified matching face or playable numeric mapping. [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], PDF pages 2 and 48, and the PC sheet, cover and PDF page 3, carry distinct final sentences. The published PC sentence ends “While present, may reduce Han’s forfeit to zero here.”<ref name="pc-sheet-3">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Decipher Errata], [[Players Committee]], cover and PDF page 3 (official text as of 1 January 2013). The cover identifies the included errata as issued since the Committee took over development. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The old conflated Errata article’s images carry these PC words.

The existing <code>4_100</code> identity is preserved on [[Dengar (PC Errata)]]; its association with the current PC card/image is present in the official card-data row and the target blueprint. The machine/Java display-text omission of “here” is a separate transcription discrepancy, not grounds to remove that approved ID or proof of a mechanical gameplay defect. [[Dengar (Errata)]] keeps numeric and face fields blank absent verified mappings; its stable documentary publication identity is retained. Existing <code>4_100o</code> on [[Dengar]] and <code>54_100</code> on [[Dengar (Revised)]] are unchanged. The existing [[Card:4_100d]] documentation route is preserved without claiming an implemented playable blueprint; [[Card:4_100]] is proposed to resolve to the PC state after the split.

The exact existing capture dated 9 August 2016 was opened and its complete PDF bytes matched SHA-256 <code>3b04cf5070d570fd0f02dda954388c1be57dae859881e554a6e74ab872aa7630</code> (17,127,401 bytes). This proposal reuses Root’s checked source, independent private backup and existing central metadata record; it does not fetch, submit or back up the source again. The cover’s “Official text as of January 1, 2013” is a text-as-of statement, not an established public-release or first-effective date. Exact first release remains unknown.

This fragment replaces an unpublished local proposal note that incorrectly left the PC identity blank and called the PDF locator unresolved. Preserve all existing live Talk comments and page history; fresh source, redirect and Talk guards are still required before any save.
